project.description: GCP project ID where the policy binding is applied. Must follow valid project naming rules (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens).
project.rationale: Ensures IAM policy is attached to a valid and controlled project scope.

location.description: Location of the policy binding. Must always be global for IAM project policy bindings.
location.rationale: IAM bindings must be globally consistent for proper access control enforcement.

policy_binding_id.description: Unique identifier for the policy binding within the project.
policy_binding_id.rationale: Ensures each IAM binding can be uniquely tracked and managed.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name for the policy binding (maximum 63 characters).
display_name.rationale: Used only for identification and has no security impact.
display_name.non-compliant: This is an extremely long invalid display name that exceeds allowed character limits for IAM resources

annotations.description: Optional metadata used to tag and classify the policy binding.
annotations.rationale: Annotations are informational only and do not affect IAM enforcement.

non-compliant.note: This annotation contains excessive invalid metadata that should not be used in production IAM configurations because it violates expected structure and readability standards

policy_kind.description: Type of policy being applied. Possible values include ACCESS or PRINCIPAL_ACCESS_BOUNDARY.
policy_kind.rationale: Determines IAM enforcement behavior and access model.

target.description: Full resource name of the target project where the policy binding is applied.
target.rationale: Defines exact IAM enforcement scope at project level.

principal_set.description: Principal set defining which identities are allowed within the project scope.
principal_set.rationale: Restricts access to approved identities within project boundary.

condition.description: Optional IAM condition using Common Expression Language (CEL) for conditional access control.
condition.rationale: Allows fine-grained access control based on logical conditions.

compliant.title: Project access rule
compliant.description: Allows access only to project resources

expression.description: CEL expression used to define IAM conditional logic.
expression.rationale: Controls when IAM policy is applied.

title.description: Short title describing the IAM condition.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the IAM condition.
description.compliant: Restricts access to project-level resources only

location.description: Debugging reference for IAM condition evaluation.
location.rationale: Used for error tracing and debugging.
